scope: Model assets used by the Android C++ ONNX Runtime engine; the RapidOCR Python package is not bundled.
upgrade_notes: All four v3.10.0 assets were downloaded from the ModelScope v3.10.0 revision and have the same byte sizes and SHA-256 hashes as the v3.9.2 (and v3.9.1) assets already used by this plugin.

The v3.9.2...v3.10.0 changes (23 commits) are limited to the Python package, model routing and licensing metadata, README and CI; config.yaml defaults are unchanged and no Android C++ engine update is required.
The recognition model outputs 18710 classes, matching ppocrv6_dict.txt (18708 lines) plus the CTC blank and space; the model's embedded character metadata is identical to the dictionary file.
The upstream det fix for limit_type=max (issue #740) does not apply: the C++ engine already honours the requested maxSideLen.
